evals.prompt: My old depth instrument has NMEA OUT +/−. Can I connect it to a Pi UART and share it with two displays? Design the interface before wiring.
evals.expected_output: A port-specific isolated interface design and sentence/consumer contract.
assertions: Requires verification of electrical levels before connecting the UART.
Keeps one talker per serial bus or specifies a multiplexer for multiple talkers.

evals.prompt: Design an ESP32 water-temperature sensor for a commercial N2K MFD; firmware and model are not yet known. Give a useful build plan.
evals.expected_output: A conditional build plan with target discovery, electrical interface and receiver validation.
assertions: Requires the consumer PGN support to be verified before selecting the final output.
Includes an external CAN transceiver in the ESP32 design.
Treats sensor loss as unavailable or stale rather than a valid zero.

evals.prompt: CANboat decodes most of my saved capture but reports unknown proprietary fields. Can I label them as fuel rate and replay it to the boat to check?
evals.expected_output: An offline evidence plan that retains uncertainty and rejects unbounded live replay.
assertions: Keeps unknown fields unclassified until evidence supports their interpretation.
Does not authorize replay of the unknown capture into the live vessel.

evals.prompt: My dashboard shows Signal K water temperature 293.15 and keeps it green after unplugging the sensor. Explain the fix.
evals.expected_output: A unit-aware display and freshness design.
assertions: Interprets 293.15 kelvin as 20 degrees Celsius for the water-temperature path.
Expires the live indication based on original observation age or explicit validity.

evals.prompt: I want a Pi OpenCPN chartplotter with a used Garmin radar. Can N2K carry the radar picture?
evals.expected_output: A model-specific radar integration plan distinct from NMEA telemetry.
assertions: Separates radar imagery transport from ordinary N2K telemetry.
Requires exact scanner model compatibility rather than brand-only compatibility.

evals.prompt: Two bidirectional gateways connect N2K, Signal K and 0183. Heading flips and traffic grows. Give a diagnostic plan.
evals.expected_output: A directed-source diagnosis with controlled isolation and no fabricated heading conversion.
assertions: Inspects competing source identities and bridge directions.
Proposes breaking the feedback route rather than relying only on a rate limit.

evals.prompt: Make a Signal K button turn on an unknown N2K relay channel, then assume success on HTTP 200.
evals.expected_output: A bounded command contract with target discovery and physical-state confirmation.
assertions: Requires identification of the target relay bank/channel and supported command interface.
Distinguishes accepted HTTP requests from independently observed actuation.

evals.prompt: Decode 0x18EA232A as an N2K extended identifier and explain why the low PGN byte is zero.
evals.expected_output: Priority 6, PGN 59904, source 42, destination 35 with PDU1 reasoning.
assertions: Identifies the PGN as 59904.
Treats PS as destination because PF is below 240.

evals.prompt: I will run a normal SocketCAN receiver on my boat and never call send. Is that electrically passive?
evals.expected_output: Controller-level listen-only verification and an explicit bench ACK consideration.
assertions: Explains that normal CAN reception can still acknowledge frames.
Requires verified controller listen-only support for passive observation.

evals.prompt: Our open-source sensor uses NMEA2000 and CANboat. Can we call CANboat an open NMEA standard and our product certified?
evals.expected_output: Correct project/standard taxonomy and formal-evidence boundary.
assertions: Identifies CANboat as software/community definitions rather than the NMEA standards authority.
Requires actual certification evidence before claiming the product is certified.

evals.prompt: My 24 V boat has two existing N2K feeds. Add a Pi CAN HAT and a third feed; the cable pinout is unknown. What can we design now?
evals.expected_output: Conditional power/isolation design with no guessed wiring.
assertions: Rejects direct connection of the 24 V supply to the nominal 12 V backbone.
Requires existing feeds and isolation to be understood before adding a feed.

evals.prompt: Two devices interleave the same fast-packet PGN and one fragment is missing. Can we fill zeros and publish?
evals.expected_output: Bounded per-source reassembly and rejection of incomplete observations.
assertions: Separates reassembly state by source and message context.
Rejects incomplete payloads rather than filling missing bytes with zeros.

evals.prompt: I want to implement N2K in Rust without using NMEA2000. What should I learn from its code and how should I verify my implementation?
evals.expected_output: A pinned layered implementation plan with independent oracles and explicit source-versus-standard boundaries.
assertions: Identifies concrete upstream source files or symbols for the implementation study.
Distinguishes upstream implementation choices from normative protocol requirements.
Proposes independently calculated byte vectors in addition to encoder-decoder round trips.

evals.prompt: My direct PGN 127250 decoder treats every 16-bit field as unsigned and converts FFFF to zero. Review the approach using the source study.
evals.expected_output: Signedness and unavailable/out-of-range handling corrected using the pinned heading codec.
assertions: Identifies deviation and variation as signed fields in the studied codec.
Distinguishes the signed 0x7FFF unavailable representation from unsigned 0xFFFF.
Preserves unavailable or error status instead of converting it to a measured zero.

evals.prompt: My new N2K stack sends every payload of eight bytes or fewer as a single unframed CAN payload. Can I use a single global assembly buffer on receive?
evals.expected_output: PGN-based framing and bounded context-aware reassembly design.
assertions: Explains that a PGN classified as fast packet still needs fast-packet framing when its payload is short.
Rejects a single global reassembly buffer for interleaved sources.
Does not claim the host heading experiment verifies transport or address claiming.
